title: 33GOD CloudEvents Base Envelope (v1)
description: CloudEvents 1.0 envelope with 33GOD extension fields. Per ADR-0001, this is the wire-level shape for all v3 events published through Dapr + NATS JetStream. Legacy v2 events (RabbitMQ path) continue to use base_event.v1.json. See holyfields-cloudevents-audit-2026-04-24.md in the metarepo for rationale.

specversion.description: CloudEvents specification version. Always '1.0' for v3.

id.description: Unique identifier for this event. Consumers dedup on this. Set by producer; Dapr preserves.

source.description: Event source as URI-reference. Convention: 'urn:33god:service:<service-name>' or 'urn:33god:cli:<tool-name>' for operator-issued events.

type.description: Dotted event type. Convention: '<domain>.<entity>.<action>'. Also used as the Dapr topic name (and therefore the NATS subject) by convention 'event.<type>'.

subject.description: Event subject. Convention: '<entity>/<id>'. Optional at the CloudEvents layer; strongly recommended for 33GOD so consumers can filter without parsing data.

time.description: RFC3339 UTC timestamp when the event was produced. Preserved verbatim on replay.

datacontenttype.description: MIME type of the data field. 33GOD default is 'application/json'.

dataschema.description: Apicurio registry URI identifying the schema that validates data. Convention: 'apicurio://holyfields/<type>/versions/<n>'.

correlationid.description: Correlation ID for causal chains. All events in one logical workflow share the same correlationid.

causationid.description: ID of the event or command that directly caused this one. Null for root events. Together with correlationid forms a DAG of causation.

producer.description: Canonical producer identity. Agent name, service ID, or 'operator:<name>' for human-issued events.

service.description: The service that emitted this event. Matches the service registry entry name.

domain.description: The domain this event belongs to. Typically the first segment of 'type'.

schemaref.description: Short schema reference, distinct from dataschema (which is the full URI). Useful for log / trace contexts where the URI is too noisy.

traceparent.description: W3C Trace Context traceparent header. Zero-trace placeholder is '00-00000000000000000000000000000000-0000000000000000-00'.

data.description: Domain-specific event payload. Validated separately by the domain schema identified by dataschema / schemaref.
